name: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Indiana - Princeton IN

fieldNotes.site: TMMI — Toyota's Indiana assembly plant (Highlander, Grand Highlander, 3-row BEV SUV; $8B total IN investment incl. $1.4B BEV retool). Large central white-roof assembly building plus ~8 supporting structures (logistics/cross-dock, paint, supplier buildings, on-site test track on the east).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced, security-controlled automotive plant set in farmland. Wide multi-lane internal approach road (Tulip Tree Drive) leads from the public road into the plant; truck entrances are controlled checkpoints. truckGate true with high confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Manned guard houses are standard at Toyota assembly-plant gates; small guard structures present at the plant entrance points. guardShack true; remoteGs false.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large drop yards: multiple distinct trailer lots on the west and east sides of the plant, each with dozens of trailers in dense rows (z16-z18 imagery). Easily 50+ band; dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Extensive dock banks along the assembly plant and logistics buildings; ~150 conservative estimate, 50+ band certain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant is surrounded by open farmland and forest buffer outside Princeton IN (pop ~8,500) — clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Separate inbound cross-dock/logistics buildings vs. finished-vehicle outbound staging lots (rows of finished cars seen on the N and E sides).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has multiple large buildings plus an on-site vehicle test track.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane approach roads and large gate aprons leave clear room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur serves the plant (standard for an assembly plant of this scale; rail-served areas visible on campus).
fieldNotes.perimeter: Box covers the core developed plant campus; TMMI owns substantial additional open buffer land beyond it.
